text:
jason (neteng): Opening follow-up thread for the 3/22 routing/TLS storm — postmortem linked below, sharing action items and owners. Please ack and add blockers.

incidents-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/NE-401-routing-tls-storm — auto-summary + timeline attached.

maria (sre): I can own the DNS TTL rollback and the staging test plan. ETA EOD Thu.

sam (platform): I'll take the routing shadow-rule rollback playbook. Will coordinate canary steps with peggy and eng-runtime.

peggy (prod): Pinging cloud-noc for cert rotation windows. Need ~2h maintenance window. Prefer 03/26 01:00-03:00 UTC. :calendar:

jason (neteng): Action items (owners):
1) DNS TTL rollback — owner: maria — verify in staging + prod smoke.
2) Routing shadow-rule rollback playbook — owner: sam — run canary in us-east then expand.
3) TLS cert rotation automation patch — owner: peggy — PR + integration test.
4) Retry-metering & alerts per-region — owner: jason — add spike alerts and dashboard.
Please add P0/P1 labels in your PR/JIRA.

maria (sre): FYI test plan snippet:
```
# staging smoke steps
kubectl apply -f test-namespace.yaml
./tools/envoy-probe --region=us-east --duration=300s
# checks: 5m steady state, no cross-region failovers
```

sam (platform): Can we add a rollback flag to the runner? e.g. `--dry-run --apply` so we can validate steps before flip.

peggy (prod): I'll schedule cert window after cloud-noc OKs it. Adding KMS key rotation note to the ticket.

jason (neteng): Timelines: maria EOD Thu, sam COB Mon, peggy tentative Fri (depends on cloud-noc). I'll own retry dashboard by Tue. If any slip, post here and mark blockers.

maria (sre): :thumbsup: Starting staging test in 10m and will post results here.

incidents-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-26T01:00:00Z — calendar invite sent to participants.

sam (platform): @maria please include perf metrics (p99 latency, p95, error-rate) in the test artifacts.

peggy (prod): @sam we need to confirm whether shadow rollback affects traffic shaping for canaries — will sync with eng-runtime on impacts.

jason (neteng): Noted. Recurring pattern to call out in RCA: TLS handshake spikes aligned with cross-region egress bursts + low DNS TTL + routing fanout. Please add that to the final RCA notes.

maria (sre): Adding RCA note and linking eval ticket: https://redwood.local/tickets/NE-412

sam (platform): :eyes: ack, drafting playbook steps by COB Monday.

peggy (prod): Filing JIRA NE-430 for cert automation work and linking PR template.

jason (neteng): :white_check_mark: Thanks — closing the loop for now. Add updates as separate messages in this thread. If you hit a blocker, ping me and escalate to oncall.
